items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: But we had blown them out, so they were just around there. And they had this little trumpeter, a little dark trumpet player, Swift, or Swaft...Swift...

ctx.x: The Warren Hall was at 47th Street between Vincennes and St. Lawrence.

Yeah. So we played the Warren Hall. And that night the hall is packed and jammed with people. "And they say Louis is gonna come." "They say Louis is gonna come?" Yeah, Louis Armstrong is coming to meet Lee. That's his buddy. Cook said, "Yeah, Louis will be here." Sure enough, man, around ten-something, here comes Louis in the place. We're up on this bandstand. So Louis is there, they're talkin' to him, everybody's screaming, "There's Louis!" Man, Louis is a star, and the (?) wasn't much. And he's so happy to see…

So we sat down a while. So he said, "Let's play something!" But nothing happened. They're just going to wait and look at Louis, and talk about it. Then they asked him to play something. He ain't got no horn. So they had this band up, I forget which -- another band was playing. But we had blown them out, so they were just around there. And they had this little trumpeter, a little dark trumpet player, Swift, or Swaft...Swift...
